hero_description: I develop responsive web applications and mobile-friendly digital experiences using modern web technologies. I produce high-performance, scalable and user-oriented solutions with React, Laravel and strong backend architectures.
about_description_1: Hello! I am Onur Solmaz. As a newly graduated Computer Engineer, I develop user-oriented applications with modern web technologies.
about_description_2: I gained experience in frontend and backend development processes using React, Laravel, PHP and MySQL. I focus on producing scalable, high-performance and sustainable solutions.
projects_subtitle: Selected projects from my latest works.
project_vidipass_description: Web platform developed for event management and ticket sales processes. Developed API integrations, user operations and dynamic content management using React frontend and Laravel backend.
project_library_description: Modern library management system where books, users and borrowing transactions are managed.
project_task_description: Task management application where users can create, update and track tasks.
project_chat_description: Real-time messaging application developed using WebSocket technology.
project_ecommerce_description: Modern e-commerce application including product listing, basket management, user verification and order processes.
experience_description_1: I took part in software development processes during my 2-month summer internship. By working with the development team, I gained experience in the development and maintenance processes of web-based applications.
experience_description_2: I develop web applications using React and Laravel. I design user interfaces, perform REST API integrations, work on database operations and contribute to the development of scalable software solutions.

privacy_intro: This website is Onur Solmaz's personal portfolio. This page explains what limited data is processed during your visit and how it is used.
privacy_contact_text: When you use the contact form, your name, email address and message will be emailed directly to me. This information is not stored on the server, is not used for marketing purposes and is not shared with any third parties.
privacy_security_text: In order to ensure website security and performance, the hosting provider may process standard technical data such as IP address. This data is used solely for security and technical requirements.
privacy_analytics_text: This portfolio site does not use analytics tools that track visitor behavior. There is no cookie-based tracking or device fingerprinting.
privacy_cookies_text: This website does not use cookies for advertising or tracking purposes. No cookies are created other than technical cookies required by the browser.
privacy_links_text: When you click on GitHub, LinkedIn or other external links, the respective websites' own privacy policies apply. I am not responsible for the content or data processing methods of these sites.
privacy_contact_me_text: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, you can contact me via the contact form or my email address.
